title: Unforgettable experience
text: I had visited the Alhambra several times but never with a guide, and it has been a wonderful experience. Juan was charming with the children, and despite there being two historians in the group, we learned a lot. We will undoubtedly repeat this experience. Thank you, Juan. Next time, we will also visit the Albayzín.
author: mar_asF2110YU

title: Very good
text: Juan Parra has been an excellent guide with deep knowledge about the Alhambra and the history of Spain in general. It is evident that he is passionate about his work and is charming and polite.
author: susanamH1152YI

title: Incredible
text: A fantastic experience! We did not plan to take a guide, but I recommend it 100%. Our guide Juan Parra could not have been better.
author: paulamP2406LR

title: Visit Alhambra
text: We had a wonderful time during our tour of the Alhambra with our guide Juan. He is an excellent local guide with extensive knowledge of the Alhambra and Nazarí culture, and he was incredibly kind and welcoming. We couldn’t have had a better experience, we’re so grateful!
